lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Help J. K. Rowling in her writing. Indeed, Hagrid does not speak English very well due to language defects.
The f, t and g at the end of each word are replaced by the character '
The h at the begining of each word are replaced by the character '
The word you by yeh
The word to by ter
The word and by an'
The word me by meh

The sentences are considered as a Hagrid speaking if Hagrid is mentionned as the speaker, in other words, outside the quotation marks.

You have to be careful to modify only Hagrid's sentences
Case sensitive
Input
Line 1 : An integer N for the number of sentences.
N next lines : The lines to transform.
Output
N lines : The lines transformed.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 20
Example
Input
2
"You going to the forest?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.
Output
"Yeh goin' ter the fores'?" Asked Hagrid.
"No it's ok Hagrid. I just want to reach the castle before lunch." Replied Harry fearfully.
